title: Regulatory Notice: Level 3 Public Health Emergency — pH 9.6, Caustic 37 mg/L

fields.office: Division of Drinking and Ground Waters, Central District
fields.subject: Confirming Level 3 — Public Health Emergency — Verification and Next Steps
fields.applicability: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer, all personnel involved in water quality, regulatory reporting, and emergency operations
fields.authority: Ohio Revised Code § 3745.01; 40 CFR § 141.30; ERP Section 4.4
fields.purpose:
The Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District has verified the laboratory results for Sample 24-1189 collected from Zone 1 at 10:45. The pH of 9.6 and caustic dose of 37 mg/L exceed the safe limits established under the Safe Drinking Water Act and Ohio’s drinking water standards. The incident is confirmed as a Level 3 — Public Health Emergency under ERP Section 4.4. The Do Not Drink advisory remains in effect and must not be lifted until two clean sample rounds are confirmed and the Ohio EPA concurs.

This directive confirms the state’s authority to oversee emergency response and reporting during a public health threat to the drinking water supply. All actions taken by the City of Millbrook must align with federal and state emergency protocols.
actions: Submit lab data for Sample 24-1189 and all prior samples from the incident to the Ohio EPA DDAGW electronic reporting portal (DDAGW-ELR-2026) within 24 hours of this notice.
Notify the Ohio EPA Division of Drinking and Ground Waters via phone (555) 037-1555 within 1 hour of final lab verification confirming the water meets safe standards.
Maintain the Do Not Drink advisory for Zone 1 until two consecutive clean sample rounds (pH ≤ 9.0, caustic ≤ 15 mg/L) are collected and verified.
Do not initiate any return to automatic control until the control system has been fully restored and validated by the SCADA / IT Security Manager and the Ohio EPA.
Ensure that all critical customers (e.g., dialysis clinics, hospitals, nursing homes) remain on bottled water and are confirmed as receiving alternate supplies.
fields.contact: Questions: contact Carol Dugan, District Engineer, Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District, (555) 037-1555

approvedBy.name: Carol Dugan
approvedBy.title: District Engineer, Division of Drinking and Ground Waters
